bio: In the elegant resort of Dammusi di Borgo Cala Creta, surrounded by lush Mediterranean scrub, the “Giardino Arabo” is their beautiful restaurant, with tables elegantly arranged around a spectacular olive tree. Outdoors, you can enjoy a rich seafood cuisine with a modern and imaginative touch, featuring traditional recipes, including an unmissable “Seafood Caponata” enriched with unsweetened cocoa and pistachio.
